letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai whispers your name, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad carries your laughter. Today, as the calendar turns to a new chapter, I find myself marveling at the journey we began on that unforgettable 23rd of February. Your smile lights up my world like desert stars, and your love steadies my heart like the gentle flow of the Sabarmati. Thank you for being my forever cutie, my partner in adventure, and the endless source of my happiness.
poem:
In sunrise gold or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the song that eases pain.  
Across two cities, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
